title: Lysate Preparation from Biofluids/Viruses Collected with Nasal or Throat Swabs
author: Bioline
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f5cbq2w

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Tube
steps.instruction: Add 600 μL of Lysis Buffer RX to a 1.5 mL RNase-free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Collect Sample
steps.instruction: Gently brush a sterile, single-use cotton swab inside the nose or mouth.

steps.title: Transfer Sample to Buffer
steps.instruction: Using sterile techniques, cut the shaft of the cotton tip and place the tip containing the collected cells into the microcentrifuge tube containing Lysis Buffer RX.

steps.title: Incubate Lysate
steps.instruction: Close the tube, vortex gently, and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer and Measure Lysate
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, transfer the lysate into another 1.5 mL RNase-free microcentrifuge tube and note the volume of the lysate.
